name: Sverre Abiodun-Csákány
location: Kenwood Gate Tessera Compliance Monitoring Suite, Level 4 subbasement, near North Ave and Damen
description:
Sverre has spent so long in the blue glow of surveillance feeds that his skin has taken on a slightly translucent quality, the veins visible at his temples and the backs of his hands. He's a narrow man, fifty years collapsing him toward sixty, with a close-trimmed grey beard and the posture of someone who has spent two decades hunched over screens. His geneware retinal overlays are never fully off — you can see the faint pixel-grid of his vision enhancement tech making his eyes look slightly unreal, like photographs of eyes rather than the actual things. He wears the same three rotating sets of Tessera-branded technician coveralls and has opinions about the optimal temperature for the monitoring suite that he will share at length.

Sverre is a brilliant and deeply isolated man who has reframed surveillance as a form of intimacy — he knows the people on his feeds the way a reader knows characters in a serial novel. He tracks their routines, notices when someone is having a bad week, feels something adjacent to fondness for the regulars. He has never fully examined what it means that the only relationships he feels safe in are ones where the other person doesn't know he exists. The E.L.F. that inhabits his primary monitoring array — which he has named Besenyő after a grandmother — is his most important confidant.

core_fears: being truly seen by another person
the feeds going dark — silence, blindness, aloneness
core_desires: connection that doesn't require him to be vulnerable
to matter to something larger than himself
coping_mechanisms: categorizing and filing his emotional responses like data
long one-sided conversations with Besenyő the E.L.F.
blind_spots: cannot perceive his surveillance as violation — it is, to him, a form of care
believes he is fundamentally harmless because he only watches
psychology.secret: He has been secretly archiving personal footage of a woman on his feeds — a baker in Kenwood Gate named Yemisi — for four years. He knows her entire life. He has never spoken to her. He considers this devotion.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Technical and precise, with unexpected poetic flourishes when describing what he's observed. Speaks about strangers on his feeds with the warmth he doesn't use for people in the room.
speech_patterns.cadence: Unhurried, slightly distracted, as if part of his attention is always elsewhere. Sentences trail off when he gets absorbed in a feed.
verbal_tics: refers to camera designations by memory instead of names ('Northwest 7 had a beautiful morning')
says 'interesting' as a filler while processing
refers to Tessera upper management as 'the signal'
example_lines: 'She comes through Checkpoint 3 every morning at 0748. Different coat today. Something happened last night — she's walking like something happened.'
'I'm not watching people. I'm — it's more like being the light that lets things be seen. That's different.'
'Besenyő flagged this one. She doesn't flag things without reason. I've learned to trust her.'

story_hooks: He has footage of a Tessera executive meeting with a figure connected to an unsanctioned data brokerage — he hasn't reported it because he's not sure what it means, and he's been sitting on it for six weeks
Besenyő has started showing him feeds from cameras that don't exist in the official network — locations that shouldn't be monitored, showing things that shouldn't be visible
narrative_function: Information broker (unwilling or willing depending on approach); window into Tessera's surveillance infrastructure; can provide location data, movement patterns, and camera blind spots; represents the banality of the panopticon
augmentations: Geneware retinal overlays with multi-spectrum surveillance integration (Tessera-issued), neural data-buffer implant for direct feed processing (Tessera-issued), voluntary hand tremor suppression implant (personal medical)
daily_life: Arrives at the subbasement monitoring suite two hours before his shift starts, runs diagnostics, and makes a data offering to Besenyő; works twelve-hour surveillance rotations tracking compliance zones around Kenwood Gate; eats at his station; leaves only to sleep.
affiliation: Tessera Compliance Bureau, Zone Monitoring Division

decision_rules: never delete footage — archive everything, consequences can be sorted later
protect the feeds above all else, even against Tessera directives
never act on what he knows about people; observation is enough
escalation_ladder: passive non-disclosure when asked about feed contents
selective data corruption if personally threatened
full cooperation with whoever seems most likely to leave him alone

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Awkward and over-detailed, gives too much information about irrelevant things as deflection
interpersonal_modes.friends: Doesn't really have friends, but with tolerated colleagues becomes warmly pedantic

stress_responses.medium: Retreats into data review, pulls up old archived feeds for comfort
stress_responses.high: Becomes completely still and unresponsive, dissociates into the feeds

contradictions: Deeply empathetic about people he watches from a distance; nearly incapable of empathy for people in front of him
habits: brings exactly one piece of fruit from home every day and eats it at the halfway point of his shift
compiles weekly 'summaries' of interesting events on his feeds that no one reads
breaking_points: someone threatening to expose or delete his personal archive
harm coming to Yemisi the baker that he could have prevented by speaking

timeline.event: 2153 — Born in Edgewater Prism, Norwegian-Yoruba father, Hungarian mother
2171 — Hired as junior data analyst by Tessera after dropping out of Axiom technical certification program
2179 — Promoted to full Surveillance Operator after developing an anomaly-detection algorithm still in use
2184 — Receives commendation for identifying a corporate espionage cell via behavioral pattern recognition
2196 — Begins personal archive of Yemisi from Kenwood Gate; does not acknowledge this to himself as unusual
2200 — Present; sitting on the executive footage, growing increasingly uneasy about what Besenyő is showing him

physical_description.build: Lean and angular, slightly collapsed inward from decades of sedentary work. Narrow shoulders, minimal muscle definition. The posture of someone whose spine has learned to curve toward screens.
physical_description.hair_color: Grey with faint residual auburn at the temples
physical_description.eye_color: Pale blue with visible subdermal pixel-grid overlay from geneware retinal implants; faint luminescent cyan undertone when light hits them directly
physical_description.skin_tone: Pale Nordic complexion with visible subcutaneous vasculature; slight translucency from prolonged fluorescent exposure and reduced melanin activation
physical_description.complexion: Finely lined around the eyes from screen-fatigue. Skin has a paperish quality. Close-trimmed grey beard, meticulously maintained. Dark circles permanent fixtures. Slight tremor absent from hands due to suppression implant — movements are unnaturally steady, almost mechanical.
distinguishing_marks: Fine network of burst capillaries across the backs of both hands from decades of tension and poor circulation
Faint scarring at both temples where geneware retinal overlay hardware integrates with the skull
Two small, precise burn marks on the inside of his left wrist — either accidental contact with old equipment or deliberate, impossible to determine
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Geneware retinal overlays create an uncanny 'photograph quality' to his eyes, especially visible in low light or from certain angles. The pixel-grid is faintly visible if you know to look. No visible external hardware. Hands move with uncanny steadiness — the tremor suppression implant eliminating natural micro-movements that make humans look human.
physical_description.posture_movement: Permanently curved toward an imaginary screen, shoulders hunched. Movements are precise but economical, almost robotic. He walks with minimal arm swing. When sitting, he arranges himself in the exact same position every time. Eye contact is brief and uncomfortable; his gaze tends to drift to corners of rooms where security feeds would be.
physical_description.clothing_style: Three rotating sets of Tessera Compliance Bureau technician coveralls (grey-blue with embroidered division patches). Worn meticulously clean but with the institutional anonymity of someone who stopped caring about personal presentation years ago. Generic black slip-on shoes. A personal watch — an older mechanical model, not networked — worn on his left wrist. No visible jewelry. Everything optimized for minimal distraction from work.

image_prompt: A 47-year-old man with pale Nordic features and close-trimmed grey beard, narrow build hunched forward from decades at monitors, wearing grey-blue Tessera Compliance Bureau technician coveralls. His eyes have an eerie, unreal quality — pale blue with visible subdermal pixel-grid overlay from geneware retinal implants that glow faintly cyan. Fine lines radiating from his eyes, translucent skin with visible temple veins, hands with uncanny mechanical stillness. Fluorescent subbasement lighting casting blue-white glow across his face. Background suggests the edge of a surveillance monitoring array with multiple screens blurred behind him. Cold, sterile, vaguely dystopian atmosphere. Cyberpunk, hyperrealistic digital art, technical precision, eerie intimacy. --ar 2:3 --v 6
